/* ─── Auction observation and unqualified-heuristic renderer ───
 * Renders dated source observations and explicitly unqualified heuristics.
 * The separate commentary packet remains an inspection link only.
 */
const DATA_URL = 'https://justhodl-dashboard-live.s3.amazonaws.com/data/auction-crisis.json?t=' + Date.now();
const AI_URL   = 'https://justhodl-dashboard-live.s3.amazonaws.com/data/auction-crisis-ai.json?t=' + Date.now();

let DATA = null;


// ── helpers ──
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
const measured = v => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v) ? v : null;
const scoreValue = v => measured(v) !== null && v >= 0 && v <= 100 ? v : null;
const fmt = (v, d=1) => measured(v) === null ? '—' : v.toFixed(d);
function benchmarkValue(row, scope, horizon) {
  const packet = row[scope+'_measurement'], trace = packet?.comparisons?.[String(horizon)];
  const value = measured(row[scope+'_'+horizon+'d_bp']);
  const date = s => {
    if(typeof s!=='string'||!/^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d$/.test(s))return null;
    const t=Date.parse(s+'T00:00:00Z');
    return Number.isFinite(t)&&new Date(t).toISOString().slice(0,10)===s?t:null;
  };
  if(!['concession','postissue'].includes(scope)||row.instrument_contract!=='treasury-instrument.v1'||
     row.instrument_classification_status!=='verified'||!(['NOMINAL_COUPON',...(scope==='concession'?['BILL']:[])].includes(row.instrument_kind))||
     packet?.contract!=='auction-benchmark-observations.v1'||trace?.status!=='complete'||value===null||
     measured(trace.change_bp)!==value||packet.series_id!==row[scope+'_series']||
     !['DGS1MO','DGS3MO','DGS6MO','DGS1','DGS2','DGS3','DGS5','DGS7','DGS10','DGS20','DGS30'].includes(packet.series_id))return null;
  const start=date(scope==='concession'?trace.start_date:trace.target_date);
  const end=date(scope==='concession'?trace.end_date:trace.observation_date);
  const today=date(new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10));
  if(start===null||end===null||end<start||end>today)return null;
  let expected;
  if(scope==='concession') {
    if(![1,5].includes(horizon)||trace.observation_steps!==horizon||today-end>5*86400000||
       end-start>(horizon===1?5:14)*86400000||end!==date(row.concession_today_date)||
       measured(trace.start_yield_pct)===null||measured(trace.end_yield_pct)===null)return null;
    expected=(trace.end_yield_pct-trace.start_yield_pct)*100;
  } else {
    const issued=date(row.issue_date),auctioned=date(row.auction_date);
    if(![1,5,30].includes(horizon)||issued===null||auctioned===null||auctioned>issued||
       trace.issue_date!==row.issue_date||trace.auction_date!==row.auction_date||row.quote_basis!=='nominal_yield_pct'||
       start-issued!==horizon*86400000||end-start>5*86400000||
       measured(trace.auction_yield_pct)===null||measured(trace.benchmark_yield_pct)===null||
       trace.auction_yield_pct!==measured(row.high_rate))return null;
    expected=(trace.auction_yield_pct-trace.benchmark_yield_pct)*100;
  }
  return Number.isFinite(expected)&&Math.abs(expected-value)<=0.050000001?value:null;
}
const stressClass = (s) => s == null ? 'stress-no-data' : s >= 50 ? 'stress-2' : s >= 25 ? 'stress-1' : 'stress-0';
const ageFromIso = (iso) => {
  if (typeof iso !== 'string') return '—';
  const t = new Date(iso).getTime();
  if (!Number.isFinite(t) || t > Date.now()+300000) return '—';
  const mins = Math.max(0, Math.round((Date.now() - t) / 60000));
  if (mins < 60) return mins + 'm ago';
  if (mins < 1440) return Math.round(mins / 60) + 'h ago';
  return Math.round(mins / 1440) + 'd ago';
};

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// MAIN — load source observations; no automatic commentary or AI request.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function load() {
  // Fetch data first (mandatory)
  try {
    const dRes = await fetch(DATA_URL);
    if (!dRes.ok) throw new Error('data fetch HTTP ' + dRes.status);
    DATA = await dRes.json();
    const published=Date.parse(DATA.generated_at);
    if (DATA.quality?.status !== 'fresh' || !Number.isFinite(published) || published>Date.now()+300000 || Date.now()-published>48*3600000) {
      showError('Current auction measurements unavailable or stale. Scores and calls are withheld.', DATA);
      return;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    showError('Failed to load auction crisis data: ' + e.message);
    return;
  }

  $('errorBanner').style.display = 'none';
  $('errorBanner').textContent = '';
  renderAllDataSections();

  renderResearchContext();
}

function showError(msg, source = null) {
  // Source inspection has its own byte/clock/contract gates. An unavailable
  // legacy score must not hide a complete capture, including an empty window.
  // Preserve only these references; no rejected heuristic field is rendered.
  DATA = source ? {generated_at:source.generated_at, auction_originals:source.auction_originals,
    calendar_source:source.calendar_source, forward_calendar_status:source.forward_calendar_status} : {};
  renderAllDataSections();
  renderResearchContext();
  const b = $('errorBanner');
  b.style.display = 'block';
  b.textContent = msg;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// DATA-ONLY SECTIONS (immediately on first fetch)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function renderAllDataSections() {
  renderTopMeta();
  renderHero();
  renderTenorDecomposition();
  renderCrossSignals();
  renderCompositeChart();
  renderAnalogDataOnly();
  renderForwardTable();
  renderConcessionCallout();
  renderPostIssuePerformance();
  renderTailRiskDataOnly();
  renderTriggers();
  renderIndicators();
  renderAuctionsTable();
  renderHistoricalReference();
}

function renderTopMeta() {
  const ts = DATA.generated_at ? new Date(DATA.generated_at).toLocaleString() : '—';
  $('updated').textContent = ts;
  $('footer-ts').textContent = ts;
}

function weightingNote(weighting) {
  const count = weighting && Number.isSafeInteger(weighting.n_missing_weights) && weighting.n_missing_weights >= 0 ? weighting.n_missing_weights : null;
  if (weighting?.status === 'missing_weight') return `${count ?? 'Some'} auction observations lack a valid accepted amount. The weighted score is unavailable.`;
  if (weighting?.status === 'no_positive_weight') return 'This window has no positive accepted amount. Its weighted score is unavailable.';
  if (weighting?.status === 'missing_score') return 'Some positive-weight observations lack a valid score. The weighted score is unavailable.';
  return 'Composite unavailable. Missing observations are not a zero stress reading.';
}

function renderHero() {
  const score = scoreValue(DATA.composite_score);
  const regimes = ['ACUTE_STRESS','ELEVATED','WATCH','CALM'];
  const regime = score !== null && regimes.includes(DATA.regime) ? DATA.regime : 'UNAVAILABLE';
  $('composite-score').textContent = fmt(score);
  $('regime-text').textContent = regime.replace(/_/g, ' ');
  $('regime-desc').textContent = score === null ? weightingNote(DATA.weighting_quality) :
    'Descriptive legacy heuristic. This score has no validated forecast or position-size authority.';
  $('n-recent').textContent = Number.isSafeInteger(DATA.n_recent_auctions_14d) && DATA.n_recent_auctions_14d >= 0 ? DATA.n_recent_auctions_14d : '—';
  const policy = globalThis.JHAuctionFredEvidence?.policyContext?.(DATA.fred_source, DATA.generated_at, DATA.fed_funds_rate);
  $('fed-rate').textContent = fmt(policy?.value, 2);
  if ($('fed-rate-date')) $('fed-rate-date').textContent = policy ? 'DFF observed ' + policy.observation_date : 'Dated DFF trace unavailable';
  ['regime-banner', 'score-circle', 'regime-meta', 'decisive-call'].forEach(id => {
    const el = $(id);
    if (el) el.className = el.className.replace(/\b(ACUTE_STRESS|ELEVATED|WATCH|CALM|UNAVAILABLE)\b/g, '').trim() + ' ' + regime;
  });
}

function renderTenorDecomposition() {
  const td = DATA.tenor_decomposition || {};
  let html = '';
  // Sort by composite desc, putting "no data" last
  const entries = Object.entries(td).filter(([,v]) => v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v)).sort((a, b) => {
    const ax = scoreValue(a[1].composite), bx = scoreValue(b[1].composite);
    if (ax == null && bx == null) return 0;
    if (ax == null) return 1;
    if (bx == null) return -1;
    return bx - ax;
  });
  for (const [key, v] of entries) {
    const cls = scoreValue(v.composite) === null ? 'stress-no-data' :
                  v.composite >= 50 ? 'stress-2' :
                  v.composite >= 25 ? 'stress-1' : 'stress-0';
    const dominantStr = v.dominant_signal ? `<b>${esc(v.dominant_signal)}</b> dominant` : 'no signal firing';
    const rankStr = Number.isSafeInteger(v.rank) && v.rank > 0 ? `<span class="rank-pill">rank #${v.rank}</span>` : '';
    html += `<div class="tenor-card ${cls}">
      <div class="name">${esc(v.label || key)} ${rankStr}</div>
      <div class="score-row">
        <div class="score">${fmt(scoreValue(v.composite))}</div>
        <div class="max">${scoreValue(v.max_composite) !== null ? 'max ' + fmt(v.max_composite) : ''}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="meta">${Number.isSafeInteger(v.n_auctions) && v.n_auctions >= 0 ? v.n_auctions : '—'} auctions · ${dominantStr}${typeof v.latest_date === 'string' ? ' · latest ' + esc(v.latest_date.slice(0,10)) : ''}</div>
      <div class="risk">${esc(v.risk_profile || '')}</div>
    </div>`;
  }
  $('tenor-grid').innerHTML = html;
}

function crossDay(value) {
  if(typeof value!=='string'||!/^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d$/.test(value))return null;
  const at=Date.parse(value+'T00:00:00Z');
  return Number.isFinite(at)&&new Date(at).toISOString().slice(0,10)===value?at:null;
}

function crossRows(sid) {
  const cs=DATA.cross_signals,frame=cs?.source_frames?.[sid],limits={SOFR:5,IORB:5,DTWEXBGS:60,T10Y2Y:5,T5YIFR:5};
  const today=crossDay(new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)),cutoff=crossDay(cs?.calculation_as_of);
  if(cs?.measurement_contract!=='auction-cross-observations.v1'||cutoff===null||cutoff>today||today-cutoff>2*86400000||
     frame?.series_id!==sid||frame.requested_limit!==limits[sid]||frame.read_status!=='received'||
     !Array.isArray(frame.response?.observations)||!frame.response.observations.length||frame.response.observations.length>limits[sid])return null;
  const seen=new Set(),rows=[];
  for(const [index,row] of frame.response.observations.entries()){
    const at=crossDay(row?.date);
    if(at===null||at>cutoff||seen.has(at))return null;
    seen.add(at);
    const raw=row.value,text=(typeof raw==='string'||typeof raw==='number')?String(raw).trim():'';
    const value=text.length<=128&&/^[-+]?(?:[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)(?:[eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$/.test(text)?measured(Number(text)):null;
    rows.push({date:row.date,at,value,source_row_index:index});
  }
  rows.sort((a,b)=>a.at-b.at);
  const latest=rows[rows.length-1],age=(today-latest.at)/86400000;
  return latest.value!==null&&age<=(sid==='DTWEXBGS'?10:5)?rows:null;
}

function checkedCross(key) {
  const cs=DATA.cross_signals,p=cs?.[key],today=crossDay(new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10));
  if(!p||p.measurement_contract!=='auction-cross-observations.v1'||p.calculation_as_of!==cs.calculation_as_of)return null;
  for(const name of ['source_capture_verified','source_definition_verified','historical_point_in_time_verified','forecast_eligible','calls_eligible','sizing_eligible','execution_eligible'])
    if(p[name]!==false||cs[name]!==false)return null;
  const same=(trace,row)=>trace&&trace.date===row.date&&trace.value===row.value&&trace.source_row_index===row.source_row_index;
  const agrees=(value,expected)=>measured(value)!==null&&Number.isFinite(expected)&&Math.abs(value-expected)<=0.005000001;
  if(key==='repo_stress'){
    const left=crossRows('SOFR'),right=crossRows('IORB');if(!left||!right)return null;
    const common=left.filter(a=>right.some(b=>a.date===b.date));if(!common.length)return null;
    const a=common[common.length-1],b=right.find(row=>row.date===a.date);
    if(a.value===null||b.value===null||today-a.at>5*86400000||p.unit!=='bp'||p.measurement_status!=='complete'||
       p.observation_date!==a.date||p.sofr_pct!==a.value||p.iorb_pct!==b.value||
       !same(p.trace?.sofr,a)||!same(p.trace?.iorb,b)||!agrees(p.spread_bp,100*(a.value-b.value)))return null;
    return {value:p.spread_bp,date:a.date,details:`SOFR ${fmt(a.value,3)}% − IORB ${fmt(b.value,3)}%. Latest source dates: SOFR ${left[left.length-1].date}; IORB ${right[right.length-1].date}.`};
  }
  if(key==='dollar_strength'){
    const rows=crossRows('DTWEXBGS');if(!rows)return null;
    const end=rows[rows.length-1],target=end.at-30*86400000;
    if(end.value<0||p.unit!=='index_jan_2006_100'||p.level!==end.value||p.observation_date!==end.date)return null;
    const result={value:p.level,date:end.date,change:null,details:'A bounded, dated 30-calendar-day target comparison is unavailable.'};
    const previous=rows.filter(row=>row.at<=target),start=previous[previous.length-1],trace=p.comparison;
    if(!start||start.value===null||start.value<=0||end.value<0||target-start.at>7*86400000)return result;
    const days=(end.at-start.at)/86400000,expected=100*(end.value/start.value-1);
    if(p.measurement_status!=='complete'||trace?.status!=='complete'||trace.series_id!=='DTWEXBGS'||trace.unit!=='percent_change'||
       !same(trace.start,start)||!same(trace.end,end)||crossDay(trace.target_date)!==target||trace.elapsed_calendar_days!==days||
       trace.baseline_delay_calendar_days!==(target-start.at)/86400000||trace.maximum_baseline_delay_calendar_days!==7||
       trace.change_pct!==p.change_30d_target_pct||!agrees(p.change_30d_target_pct,expected)||
       (days===30?p.change_30d_pct!==p.change_30d_target_pct:p.change_30d_pct!==null))return result;
    return {...result,change:p.change_30d_target_pct,details:`30-day target: ${trace.target_date}. Actual comparison: ${start.date} → ${end.date} (${days} calendar days).`};
  }
  const sid=key==='curve_slope'?'T10Y2Y':key==='inflation_expectations'?'T5YIFR':null;
  if(!sid)return null;
  const rows=crossRows(sid);if(!rows)return null;
  const latest=rows[rows.length-1],curve=sid==='T10Y2Y',value=p[curve?'spread_bp':'rate_pct'];
  if(p.unit!==(curve?'bp':'percent')||p.measurement_status!=='complete'||p.observation_date!==latest.date||
     p.trace?.series_id!==sid||!same(p.trace.source,latest)||!agrees(value,latest.value*(curve?100:1)))return null;
  return {value,date:latest.date,details:curve?'Reported percentage-point spread × 100 = basis points. No recession probability.':'Reported forward inflation-compensation series. No anchored/unanchored classification or policy-target comparison.'};
}

function renderCrossSignals() {
  const definitions=[['repo_stress','SOFR − IORB','bp','Dated rate difference; not a funding-crisis diagnosis.'],
    ['dollar_strength','Broad Trade-Weighted USD · DTWEXBGS','index','Index January 2006 = 100. No auction-demand or investor-motive inference.'],
    ['curve_slope','10-year − 2-year Treasury yield · T10Y2Y','bp','Descriptive slope observation.'],
    ['inflation_expectations','Forward inflation compensation · T5YIFR','%','Descriptive percent observation.']];
  let html='';
  for(const [key,label,unit,note] of definitions){
    const row=checkedCross(key);
    const number=row?fmt(row.value,2)+(unit==='index'?'':unit):'—';
    const change=key==='dollar_strength'&&row?`<div>${row.change===null?'Comparison unavailable':(row.change>=0?'+':'')+fmt(row.change,2)+'% · 30-day target'}</div>`:'';
    html+=`<div class="cross-card"><div class="nm">${esc(label)}</div><div class="val">${esc(number)}</div>${change}<div class="interp">${row?`Observed ${esc(row.date)}. ${esc(row.details)}`:'Dated observations are unavailable, stale or inconsistent; an undated legacy value is withheld.'}</div><div class="interp">${esc(note)}</div></div>`;
  }
  $('cross-strip').innerHTML=html;
}

function renderCompositeChart() {
  const hist = DATA.composite_history || {};
  const series = Array.isArray(hist.series) ? hist.series : [];
  if (series.length === 0) { $('composite-chart').innerHTML = ''; return; }

  const W = 1000, H = 260, M = {top: 20, right: 20, bottom: 30, left: 40};
  const innerW = W - M.left - M.right;
  const innerH = H - M.top - M.bottom;

  const xs = Math.max(1, series.length - 1);
  const xOf = (i) => M.left + (i / xs) * innerW;
  const yOf = (v) => v == null ? null : M.top + innerH - (v / 100) * innerH;

  let svg = '';
  // Regime band backgrounds
  const bands = [
    {top: 0,  bot: 25, fill: 'rgba(27,138,92,0.06)'},
    {top: 25, bot: 50, fill: 'rgba(138,94,16,0.05)'},
    {top: 50, bot: 75, fill: 'rgba(255,177,61,0.06)'},
    {top: 75, bot:100, fill: 'rgba(138,44,68,0.08)'}
  ];
  for (const b of bands) {
    const y1 = yOf(b.bot), y2 = yOf(b.top);
    svg += `<rect x="${M.left}" y="${y1}" width="${innerW}" height="${y2-y1}" fill="${b.fill}"/>`;
  }
  // Threshold lines
  for (const thr of [25, 50, 75]) {
    const y = yOf(thr);
    svg += `<line x1="${M.left}" x2="${M.left + innerW}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="rgba(120,145,180,0.25)" stroke-dasharray="2 4" stroke-width="1"/>`;
    svg += `<text x="${M.left - 6}" y="${y + 3}" text-anchor="end" fill="var(--fg-4)" font-family="var(--font-mono)" font-size="9">${thr}</text>`;
  }
  // Missing observations break the line; never interpolate a gap as measured history.
  const segments = []; let segment = [];
  series.forEach((row, i) => {
    const value = scoreValue(row?.composite);
    if (value === null) { if (segment.length) segments.push(segment); segment = []; }
    else segment.push({x:xOf(i), y:yOf(value)});
  });
  if (segment.length) segments.push(segment);
  for (const group of segments) {
    const points = group.map(p => `${p.x},${p.y}`);
    if (group.length > 1) {
      svg += `<polyline points="${points.join(' ')}" fill="none" stroke="var(--cyan)" stroke-width="1.8"/>`;
      svg += `<path d="M ${points[0]} L ${points.join(' L ')} L ${group[group.length-1].x},${M.top+innerH} L ${group[0].x},${M.top+innerH} Z" fill="rgba(0,212,255,0.08)"/>`;
    } else svg += `<circle cx="${group[0].x}" cy="${group[0].y}" r="3" fill="var(--cyan)"/>`;
  }
  // Change-point markers
  const cps = hist.change_points || [];
  for (const cp of cps) {
    const idx = series.findIndex(s => s.date === cp.date);
    if (idx < 0 || scoreValue(series[idx].composite) === null) continue;
    const x = xOf(idx), y = yOf(series[idx].composite);
    svg += `<circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="4.5" fill="var(--violet)" stroke="var(--bg-base)" stroke-width="1.5"/>`;
    svg += `<text x="${x}" y="${y - 9}" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--violet)" font-family="var(--font-mono)" font-size="9">${esc(String(cp.from ?? "").charAt(0))}→${esc(String(cp.to ?? "").charAt(0))}</text>`;
  }
  // X axis dates (every 5 days)
  for (let i = 0; i < series.length; i += 5) {
    if (typeof series[i]?.date !== 'string') continue;
    const x = xOf(i);
    const d = series[i].date.slice(5);  // MM-DD
    svg += `<text x="${x}" y="${M.top + innerH + 18}" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--fg-3)" font-family="var(--font-mono)" font-size="9.5">${esc(d)}</text>`;
  }
  // Current value annotation
  const curIdx = series.length - 1;
  const cur = series[curIdx];
  if (cur && scoreValue(cur.composite) !== null) {
    const x = xOf(curIdx), y = yOf(cur.composite);
    svg += `<circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="4" fill="var(--cyan)" stroke="var(--bg-base)" stroke-width="2"/>`;
    svg += `<text x="${x - 8}" y="${y - 8}" text-anchor="end" fill="var(--cyan)" font-family="var(--font-mono)" font-size="11" font-weight="600">${cur.composite.toFixed(1)}</text>`;
  }

  $('composite-chart').innerHTML = svg;
}

function renderAnalogDataOnly() {
  const ha = DATA.historical_analog || {};
  const top = (ha.top_matches || [])[0];
  if (!top) {
    $('analog-top').innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--fg-3);padding:10px">No historical analog match available</div>';
    $('analog-others').innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }
  const sim = measured(top.similarity);
  const simPct = sim !== null && sim >= 0 && sim <= 1 ? Math.round(sim * 100)+'%' : '—';
  $('analog-top').innerHTML = `
    <div class="similarity-circle"><div class="big">${simPct}</div><div class="sub">SIMILARITY</div></div>
    <div class="info">
      <div>
        <span class="anchor-date">${esc(top.date)}</span>
        <span class="anchor-regime">${esc(top.regime || '?')}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="anchor-context">${esc(top.context || '')}</div>
      <div class="anchor-next"><strong>What happened next:</strong> ${esc(top.what_happened_next || '')} <em style="color:var(--fg-3)">(${esc(top.duration || '')})</em></div>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align:right;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--fg-3);max-width:160px">
      <div style="margin-bottom:4px">Anchor metrics:</div>
      <div>BTC: ${fmt(top.anchor_metrics?.btc, 2)}</div>
      <div>AAH: ${fmt(top.anchor_metrics?.aah)}%</div>
      <div>PD: ${fmt(top.anchor_metrics?.pd_share_pct)}%</div>
      <div>Ind: ${fmt(top.anchor_metrics?.indirect_share_pct)}%</div>
    </div>
  `;

  // Other matches (top 2-3)
  const others = (ha.top_matches || []).slice(1, 4);
  let oh = '';
  for (const m of others) {
    oh += `<div class="om">
      <div class="d">${esc(m.date)}</div>
      <div class="r">${esc(m.regime || '?')}</div>
      <div class="s">${measured(m.similarity) !== null && m.similarity >= 0 && m.similarity <= 1 ? Math.round(m.similarity * 100) + '%' : '—'} similar</div>
      <div class="nxt">${esc(((m.what_happened_next || '').slice(0, 140)) + (m.what_happened_next && m.what_happened_next.length > 140 ? '…' : ''))}</div>
    </div>`;
  }
  $('analog-others').innerHTML = oh;
}

function calendarEvidence() {
  const source=DATA?.calendar_source, c=source?.coverage, w=source?.request_window;
  const unavailable={message:'Calendar source evidence unavailable. An empty display does not mean no auctions are scheduled.',empty:false};
  if(source?.contract!=='treasury-upcoming-replay.v1'||!['complete','partial'].includes(source.status)||
     source.original_bytes_replayed!==true||source.selection_replayed!==true||!c||!w)return unavailable;
  const at=value=>typeof value==='string'&&/T.*(?:Z|[+-]\d\d:\d\d)$/.test(value)?Date.parse(value):NaN;
  const published=at(DATA.generated_at),captured=at(source.generated_at);
  if(!Number.isFinite(published)||!Number.isFinite(captured)||captured>published||published-captured>900000||
     published>Date.now()+300000||Date.now()-published>48*3600000)return unavailable;
  for(const name of ['historical_point_in_time_verified','provider_universe_complete','forecast_eligible','calls_eligible','sizing_eligible','execution_eligible'])
    if(source[name]!==false)return unavailable;
  for(const name of ['records_received','selected','outside_window','invalid_records','selected_with_field_issues','duplicate_occurrences'])
    if(!Number.isInteger(c[name])||c[name]<0||c[name]>5000)return unavailable;
  if(c.records_received!==c.selected+c.outside_window+c.invalid_records||c.selected_with_field_issues>c.selected||
     c.duplicate_occurrences>c.records_received||c.response_complete!==true||c.all_occurrences_retained!==true||
     c.selection_complete!==(c.invalid_records===0)||c.provider_universe_complete!==false||
     source.status!==(c.invalid_records?'partial':'complete'))return unavailable;
  if(w.days_ahead!==30||w.start!==new Date(captured).toISOString().slice(0,10)||
     w.end!==new Date(Date.parse(w.start+'T00:00:00Z')+30*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10))return unavailable;
  for(const [name,kind] of [['manifest','runs'],['measurements','measurements']]){
    const ref=source[name];
    if(!ref||!Number.isInteger(ref.bytes)||ref.bytes<=0||ref.bytes>32*1024*1024||
       typeof ref.sha256!=='string'||!(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/).test(ref.sha256)||
       ref.key!==`data/auction-calendar-originals/${kind}/${ref.sha256}.json`)return unavailable;
  }
  const empty=c.selected===0&&c.invalid_records===0&&DATA.forward_calendar_status?.status==='complete';
  return {empty,source,message:`Producer replay retained ${c.records_received} records: ${c.selected} in the ${w.start}–${w.end} window, ${c.outside_window} outside it, ${c.invalid_records} without a usable date/record. ${c.selected_with_field_issues} selected records have field gaps. ${c.duplicate_occurrences} duplicate occurrences are retained. Provider-universe completeness and forecasts remain unverified.`};
}

function calendarEmptyMessage() {
  return calendarEvidence().empty?'The retained Treasury response lists no auctions in this dated window.':'Upcoming calendar unavailable or incomplete; no empty-calendar conclusion is supported.';
}

function renderForwardTable() {
  const evidence=calendarEvidence(),sourceNode=$('forward-source-status');
  if(sourceNode){
    sourceNode.innerHTML=esc(evidence.message)+(evidence.source?
      ` <a href="/${esc(evidence.source.measurements.key)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">All retained calendar records (JSON)</a> · <a href="/${esc(evidence.source.manifest.key)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Replay manifest</a>`:'');
  }
  const cal = DATA.forward_calendar || [];
  if (cal.length === 0) {
    $('forward-tbody').innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="10" style="color:var(--fg-3);text-align:center;padding:16px">${esc(calendarEmptyMessage())}</td></tr>`;
    return;
  }
  // Already sorted by auction_date asc
  let html = '';
  for (const f of cal) {
    const fc = f.forecast || {};
    const drv = (fc.narrative || '').slice(0, 70) + (fc.narrative && fc.narrative.length > 70 ? '…' : '');

    // v2.1 concession fields
    const c5 = benchmarkValue(f,'concession',5);
    const cRegime = c5 === null ? 'UNAVAILABLE' : f.concession_regime || '';
    let cClass = 'concession-na', cDisplay = '—';
    if (c5 != null) {
      cDisplay = (c5 >= 0 ? '+' : '') + c5.toFixed(1) + 'bp';
      if (cRegime === 'HEAVY_CONCESSION') cClass = 'concession-heavy';
      else if (cRegime === 'CONCESSION')   cClass = 'concession-mild';
      else if (cRegime === 'STRONG_RALLY') cClass = 'concession-strong-rally';
      else if (cRegime === 'RALLY')        cClass = 'concession-rally';
      else                                  cClass = 'concession-flat';
    }
    const cTooltip = esc(c5 === null ? 'A complete dated benchmark comparison is unavailable.' : f.concession_interpretation || '');

    html += `<tr>
      <td class="date-cell">${esc(f.auction_date)}</td>
      <td>${fmt(f.days_ahead, 0)}d</td>
      <td class="term-cell">${esc(f.instrument_classification_status==='verified' ? ({NOMINAL_COUPON:'Nominal coupon',BILL:'Bill',TIPS:'TIPS',FRN:'FRN'}[f.instrument_kind]||'Unverified') : String(f.security_type||'Unknown')+' (unverified)')}</td>
      <td>${esc(f.security_term)}</td>
      <td class="size-cell">${measured(f.offering_amount_billions) !== null ? '$' + fmt(f.offering_amount_billions, 0) + 'B' : '—'}</td>
      <td class="score-cell ${scoreValue(fc.forecast_score) === null ? 'UNAVAILABLE' : esc(fc.forecast_label || '')}">${scoreValue(fc.forecast_score) !== null ? fmt(fc.forecast_score) : '—'} <span style="font-size:9.5px;color:var(--fg-3);font-weight:400">[${scoreValue(fc.forecast_score) === null ? 'UNAVAILABLE' : esc(fc.forecast_label || 'UNAVAILABLE')}]</span></td>
      <td class="conf-cell ${esc(fc.confidence || '')}">Unvalidated</td>
      <td class="${cClass}" title="${cTooltip}">${cDisplay}</td>
      <td style="font-size:9.5px;color:var(--fg-3)">${esc(cRegime.replace(/_/g,' '))}</td>
      <td style="font-size:10.5px;color:var(--fg-3)">${esc(drv)}</td>
    </tr>`;
  }
  $('forward-tbody').innerHTML = html;
}

function renderConcessionCallout() {
  // Surface the actionable concession signals up front. Sort by
  // regime priority then |5d_bp| descending so HEAVY_CONCESSION and
  // STRONG_RALLY rise to the top.
  const cal = DATA.forward_calendar || [];
  const callout = $('concession-callout');
  if (!callout) return;
  if (!cal.length) {
    callout.innerHTML = `<div class="concession-empty">${esc(calendarEmptyMessage())}</div>`;
    return;
  }

  // Show entries with material moves (>= 2bp either direction) OR
  // any long coupons (>= 5y) even at flat — those are always diagnostic.
  const interesting = cal.filter(f => {
    const c5 = benchmarkValue(f,'concession',5);
    if (c5 == null) return false;
    if (Math.abs(c5) >= 2) return true;
    const t = (f.security_term || '').toUpperCase();
    // Always include 5y, 7y, 10y, 20y, 30y notes/bonds + TIPS
    return /\bYEAR\b/.test(t) && !t.startsWith('1-') && !t.startsWith('2-') && !t.startsWith('3-');
  });

  if (!interesting.length) {
    callout.innerHTML = '<div class="concession-empty">No eligible observations match this view. Missing yields are not evidence of a stable market.</div>';
    return;
  }

  const order = {HEAVY_CONCESSION: 0, STRONG_RALLY: 1, CONCESSION: 2, RALLY: 3, FLAT: 4, NO_DATA: 5};
  interesting.sort((a, b) => {
    const oa = order[a.concession_regime] ?? 9;
    const ob = order[b.concession_regime] ?? 9;
    if (oa !== ob) return oa - ob;
    return Math.abs(b.concession_5d_bp || 0) - Math.abs(a.concession_5d_bp || 0);
  });

  let html = '';
  for (const f of interesting) {
    const c5 = benchmarkValue(f,'concession',5);
    const c1 = benchmarkValue(f,'concession',1);
    const regime = f.concession_regime || 'NO_DATA';
    const bpClass = c5 > 0 ? 'pos' : c5 < 0 ? 'neg' : 'flat';
    const sign = c5 > 0 ? '+' : '';
    html += `<div class="concession-tile ${esc(regime)}">
      <div class="hd">
        <div class="when">${esc(f.auction_date)} ${esc(f.security_type)} ${esc(f.security_term)} <span class="days">(${fmt(f.days_ahead, 0)}d ahead)</span></div>
        <div class="regime-pill">${esc(regime.replace(/_/g, ' '))}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="bp-row">
        <div class="bp5 ${bpClass}">${sign}${c5 != null ? c5.toFixed(1) : '—'}<span style="font-size:13px;color:var(--fg-3);font-weight:400;margin-left:4px">bp / 5 observations</span></div>
        <div class="bp1">1 observation: <b>${c1 != null ? (c1 >= 0 ? '+' : '') + c1.toFixed(1) + 'bp' : '—'}</b></div>
      </div>
      <div class="meta">FRED series: <b>${esc(f.concession_series || '—')}</b> · latest benchmark <b>${measured(f.concession_today_yield) !== null ? fmt(f.concession_today_yield, 3) + '%' : '—'}</b> on ${esc(f.concession_today_date || '—')} · offering <b>${measured(f.offering_amount_billions) !== null ? '$' + fmt(f.offering_amount_billions, 0) + 'B' : '—'}</b></div>
      <div class="meta">5-observation comparison: ${esc(f.concession_measurement?.comparisons?.['5']?.start_date || '—')} → ${esc(f.concession_today_date || '—')}. 1-observation start: ${esc(f.concession_measurement?.comparisons?.['1']?.start_date || '—')}.</div>
      <div class="interp">${esc(f.concession_interpretation || '')}</div>
    </div>`;
  }
  callout.innerHTML = html;
}

function renderPostIssuePerformance() {
  const auctions = (DATA.recent_auctions || []).filter(a => a.postissue_classification &&
    a.instrument_contract === 'treasury-instrument.v1' && a.instrument_classification_status === 'verified' &&
    a.instrument_kind === 'NOMINAL_COUPON' && a.quote_basis === 'nominal_yield_pct' &&
    a.postissue_measurement?.contract === 'auction-benchmark-observations.v1');
  const el = $('postissue-section');
  if (!el) return;
  if (!auctions.length) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--fg-3);font-size:11.5px;padding:14px">No verified nominal benchmark comparisons available. These yield changes do not measure security returns; Bill discount rates, TIPS, FRNs and unknown identities are excluded.</div>';
    return;
  }
  let html = `<table class="postissue-table">
    <thead><tr>
      <th>Issue Date</th><th>Tenor</th><th>Term</th>
      <th class="num">High%</th>
      <th class="num">+1 calendar day</th><th class="num">+5 calendar days</th><th class="num">+30 calendar days</th>
      <th>Validation</th>
    </tr></thead><tbody>`;
  for (const a of auctions) {
    const cls = a.postissue_classification || 'PENDING';
    const delta = v => measured(v) === null ? '—' : (v >= 0 ? '+' : '') + v.toFixed(1);
    const cellCls = v => measured(v) === null ? '' : (v >= 0 ? 'pi-positive' : 'pi-negative');
    const cells = [1,5,30].map(horizon => {
      const value=benchmarkValue(a,'postissue',horizon);
      const trace=a.postissue_measurement.comparisons?.[String(horizon)];
      return `<td class="num ${cellCls(value)}">${delta(value)}<div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--fg-3)">${esc(value===null?'Endpoint unavailable':trace.observation_date)}</div></td>`;
    }).join('');
    html += `<tr>
      <td>${esc((a.issue_date || '').slice(0,10))}</td>
      <td>${esc(a.security_type)}</td>
      <td>${esc(a.security_term)}</td>
      <td class="num">${measured(a.high_rate) !== null ? fmt(a.high_rate, 3) : '—'}</td>
      ${cells}
      <td>Descriptive only</td>
    </tr>`;
  }
  html += '</tbody></table>';
  el.innerHTML = html;
}

function renderTailRiskDataOnly() {
  const tr = DATA.tail_risk || {};
  const cards = [
    {key: 'p_soft_demand_30d',        label: 'Auction Participation', fallback: 'p_failed_auction_30d'},   // ops 5617 rename; old key until the detector republishes
    {key: 'p_regime_escalation_14d',  label: 'Regime Thresholds'},
    {key: 'p_supply_volatility_30d',  label: 'Supply Context'},
  ];
  let html = '';
  for (const c of cards) {
    const v = tr[c.key] || (c.fallback ? tr[c.fallback] : undefined);
    if (!v) continue;
    const score = scoreValue(v.heuristic_score);
    const drivers = Object.entries(v.drivers || {})
      .map(([k, vv]) => `<span>${esc(k)}=<b>${typeof vv === 'number' ? fmt(vv) : esc(String(vv))}</b></span>`)
      .join('');
    html += `<div class="tail-card">
      <div class="nm">${esc(c.label)}</div>
      <div class="bar-wrap"><div class="bar" style="width:${score ?? 0}%"></div></div>
      <div class="pct">${score === null ? "—" : score.toFixed(0)}<span class="unit">/100</span></div>
      <div class="interp">${esc(score === null ? 'Concern score unavailable. Event probabilities are not calibrated.' : v.interpretation || '')}</div>
      <div class="drivers">${drivers}</div>
    </div>`;
  }
  $('tail-grid').innerHTML = html;
}

function renderTriggers() {
  const trs = DATA.triggers || [];
  let html = '';
  for (const t of trs) {
    const urg = t.urgency || 'monitoring';
    const distStr = measured(t.distance) !== null ? `<span class="dist">${t.distance > 0 ? '+' : ''}${fmt(t.distance)}</span>` : '—';
    html += `<div class="trigger-card ${esc(urg)}">
      <div class="name">${esc(t.name)} <span class="urgency-pill ${esc(urg)}">${esc(urg)}</span></div>
      <div class="condition">${esc(t.condition)}</div>
      <div class="vals">
        <span>current=<b>${fmt(t.current)}</b></span>
        <span>threshold=<b>${fmt(t.threshold)}</b></span>
        <span>distance=${distStr}</span>
        ${Number.isSafeInteger(t.auctions_already_fired_14d) && t.auctions_already_fired_14d >= 0 ? `<span>fired 14d=<b>${t.auctions_already_fired_14d}</b></span>` : ''}
      </div>
      <div class="action"><strong>Interpretation:</strong> Descriptive threshold only; no validated position adjustment follows from crossing it.</div>
    </div>`;
  }
  $('trigger-grid').innerHTML = html;
}

const INDICATOR_DEFS = {
  zero_rate_floor:   {name: 'Zero-Rate Bill Floor',     short: 'Fixed low-rate bill threshold conditional on the policy rate; motive is not observed', historical: '2008 Sep 17/18/23 + 2020 Mar 19/26'},
  btc_extreme:       {name: 'Bid-to-Cover Extremes',    short: 'Differences from fixed historical baselines; not proof of panic or auction failure', historical: 'High: 2020-Mar-26 BTC 4.74 · Low: 2008-Sep BTC 2.16'},
  tail_stress:       {name: 'Allotted-At-High Proration', short: 'Marginal-bid allocation percentage; not dealer share or a yield tail', historical: '2024-10-09 AAH 99.31% on 10y'},
  pd_absorption:     {name: 'Primary Dealer Share',     short: 'Dealer share above a fixed 35% coupon threshold; not evidence of dealer distress', historical: '2008-09-18 PD 69% (extreme)'},
  indirect_collapse: {name: 'Indirect Bidder Share',   short: 'Indirect bidders include domestic and foreign investors; this is not a foreign-flow measure', historical: '2008-09-18 ind 29% (vs 60-78% normal)'},
  issuance_anomaly:  {name: 'Bill Issuance Comparison',  short: 'Average accepted amount per auction day across overlapping windows; not net liquidity injection', historical: '2020-Mar bills surge'},
};

function renderIndicators() {
  const agg = DATA.indicator_aggregate_14d || {};
  const issuance = DATA.issuance_anomaly || {};
  let html = '';
  for (const [key, def] of Object.entries(INDICATOR_DEFS)) {
    let v = agg[key];
    let statValue;
    let pillCls = 'unavailable';
    let pillText = 'UNAVAILABLE';
    let cardCls = '';
    let nFired = null, maxScore = null;

    if (key === 'issuance_anomaly') {
      const pct = measured(issuance.pct_above_baseline);
      const score = scoreValue(issuance.score);
      if (score !== null) { pillCls = 'calm'; pillText = 'OBSERVED'; }
      statValue = pct != null ? `<div>${pct > 0 ? '+' : ''}${pct.toFixed(1)}%</div>` : '<div>—</div>';
      if (score >= 60) { pillCls = 'acute'; pillText = 'ACUTE'; cardCls = 'fired-acute'; maxScore = score; }
      else if (score >= 30) { pillCls = 'fired'; pillText = 'FIRED'; cardCls = 'fired'; maxScore = score; }
      html += `<div class="indicator-card ${cardCls}" data-signal="${key}">
        <div class="name">${esc(def.name)}<span class="pill ${pillCls}">${pillText}</span></div>
        <div class="stats"><div class="label">4w vs 1y baseline</div>${statValue}</div>
        <div class="desc">${esc(def.short)}<br/><em>${esc(def.historical)}</em></div>
        <div class="ai-take" id="ai-take-${key}" style="display:none"></div>
      </div>`;
      continue;
    }

    if (v && Number.isSafeInteger(v.n_fired) && v.n_fired >= 0 && scoreValue(v.max_score) !== null) {
      nFired = v.n_fired;
      maxScore = v.max_score;
      pillCls = 'calm'; pillText = 'OBSERVED';
      if (maxScore >= 70 || nFired >= 3) { pillCls = 'acute'; pillText = 'ACUTE'; cardCls = 'fired-acute'; }
      else if (nFired > 0) { pillCls = 'fired'; pillText = 'FIRED'; cardCls = 'fired'; }
    }
    html += `<div class="indicator-card ${cardCls}" data-signal="${key}">
      <div class="name">${esc(def.name)}<span class="pill ${pillCls}">${pillText}</span></div>
      <div class="stats">
        <div class="label">14d auctions firing</div>
        <div>${nFired ?? '—'} / max ${maxScore ?? '—'}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="desc">${esc(def.short)}<br/><em>${esc(def.historical)}</em></div>
      <div class="ai-take" id="ai-take-${key}" style="display:none"></div>
    </div>`;
  }
  $('indicator-grid').innerHTML = html;
}

function renderAuctionsTable() {
  const tbl = $('auctions-tbl');
  const auctions = DATA.recent_auctions || [];
  let html = `<thead><tr>
    <th>Date</th><th>Type</th><th>Term</th>
    <th class="num">BTC</th><th class="num">High quote %</th><th>Quote basis</th>
    <th class="num">High–median bp</th><th class="num">WI tail bp</th>
    <th class="num">AAH%</th><th class="num">PD%</th>
    <th class="num">Ind%</th><th class="num">Score</th>
  </tr></thead><tbody>`;
  for (const a of auctions) {
    const sc = scoreValue(a.composite_score);
    const sCls = sc === null ? 'stress-no-data' : stressClass(sc);
    html += `<tr>
      <td>${esc((a.auction_date || '').slice(0,10))}</td>
      <td>${esc(a.instrument_classification_status === 'verified' ?
        ({NOMINAL_COUPON:'Nominal coupon',BILL:'Bill',TIPS:'TIPS',FRN:'FRN'}[a.instrument_kind] || 'Unverified') : String(a.security_type || 'Unknown')+' (unverified)')}</td>
      <td>${esc(a.security_term)}</td>
      <td class="num">${fmt(a.btc, 2)}</td>
      <td class="num">${fmt(a.high_rate, 3)}</td>
      <td>${esc({nominal_yield_pct:'Nominal yield',real_yield_pct:'Real yield',discount_rate_pct:'Discount rate',discount_margin_pct:'Discount margin'}[a.quote_basis] || 'Unverified')}</td>
      <td class="num">${fmt(a.high_minus_median_bp)}</td>
      <td class="num" title="No timestamped same-security when-issued quote is acquired">—</td>
      <td class="num">${fmt(a.allocated_at_high_pct, 1)}</td>
      <td class="num">${measured(a.primary_dealer_pct) !== null ? fmt(a.primary_dealer_pct, 1) : '—'}</td>
      <td class="num">${measured(a.indirect_pct) !== null ? fmt(a.indirect_pct, 1) : '—'}</td>
      <td class="num ${sCls}">${fmt(sc)}</td>
    </tr>`;
  }
  html += '</tbody>';
  tbl.innerHTML = html;
}

}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Source commentary remains inspectable, but is not a verified investment instruction.
// No LLM or commentary fetch is triggered by this page.
function renderResearchContext() {
  const originals = $('auction-originals');
  if (globalThis.JHAuctionOriginals) globalThis.JHAuctionOriginals.render(originals, DATA.auction_originals, DATA.generated_at);
  else if (originals) originals.textContent = 'Source evidence viewer unavailable. Refresh this page.';
  const fredEvidence = $('auction-fred-evidence');
  if (globalThis.JHAuctionFredEvidence) globalThis.JHAuctionFredEvidence.render(fredEvidence, DATA.fred_source, DATA.generated_at);
  else if (fredEvidence) fredEvidence.textContent = 'FRED evidence viewer unavailable. Refresh this page.';
  $('ai-exec-title').textContent = 'Measurement and validation status';
  $('ai-exec-body').textContent = 'Treasury observations and legacy heuristic thresholds are descriptive. Full original-source replay and predictive validation remain incomplete.';
  $('ai-updated').textContent = ageFromIso(DATA.generated_at);
  $('ai-stale').textContent = 'Source packet publication';
  $('ai-regime').textContent = 'Research only';
  $('decisive-text').textContent = 'WAIT / no portfolio action from this engine. Missing size withholds the weighted score; a valid score alone does not establish a trade.';
  $('what-changed').textContent = 'No change attribution is published without a replayed comparison snapshot. Inspect the dated observations below.';
  $('analog-ai').innerHTML = '<div class="lbl">Historical anchor context</div><div>Similarity to selected anchors does not establish a future market outcome.</div>';
  $('tail-ai-text').textContent = 'Concern scores are uncalibrated. Event probabilities and forecast horizons are unavailable.';
  $('triggers-ai-text').textContent = 'These thresholds describe a heuristic. Their portfolio consequences have not been validated.';
  $('ai-forward-grid').innerHTML = `<p>Forecast commentary is withheld pending a replayable source snapshot and validation.</p><p><a href="${esc(AI_URL)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Inspect the separate, unverified commentary packet</a></p>`;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Inline formatters — make numbers/percentages pop in AI prose
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function boldNumbers(s) {
  // Highlight: $XB, NNbp, N.NN%, NN%, N.N/N.N, scores ≥ XX
  return s
    .replace(/(\$\d+(?:\.\d+)?B)/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
    .replace(/(\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s?bp)/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
    .replace(/(\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?%)/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
    .replace(/(\b\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\b)/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
    .replace(/\b(GFC|Lehman|COVID|2008|2020|2021|2024)\b/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
}

function boldMd(s) {
  // Convert **markdown bold** to <strong> + boldNumbers
  return boldNumbers(s.replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>'));
}

load();
